ai_briefing.morning_summary: Crypto markets opened sharply lower, led by Bitcoin down 3.7% and Ethereum down 5% amid disappointment over the Senate's failure to pass the CLARITY Act. The broader downturn is echoed across major tokens, with XRP plunging over 11%, while new listings on Delta India provide limited upside.
